units: Yoma 76ᵇ יין … י׳ לעולם wine is called yayin (cmp. וַי), because it brings lamentation into the world (cmp. אַלְלַי a. וַיָּנַיָּא); Snh. 70ᵇ top.—Pl. יְלָלוֹת.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 32:8">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXII</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 102:11">Yalk. Gen. 102</cite>.
